name: Satellites
author: HamDash
description: Amateur satellites: where they are now, which are above you, and when the next pass is

group.label: Which satellites
group.help: Celestrak's own groupings. 'amateur' is the ham satellites and is what most operators want; 'stations' is the ISS and friends.

min_elevation.label: Lowest useful elevation (deg)
min_elevation.help: Passes that never climb above this are not listed. Below about 10 degrees most stations are into the trees and the noise.

hours.label: Look ahead (hours)
hours.help: How far ahead to search for passes.
